1980: ~54,000 nuclear warheads around the world

That was how we "banned" nuclear weapons. When you hear "ban A" you should automatically translate it to "ensure that only a few most powerful entities can have A" in your head.
Should we unban the development of nuclear weapons then? Somehow I don't think that humanity's strength was adaptation in that regard. We banned a dangerous technology and were better off for it.
